1. General information only

Descriptions on this website are general and do not constitute engineering, mechanical, environmental, health or safety advice. They do not replace a current product label, Technical Data Sheet (TDS), Safety Data Sheet (SDS), certificate, equipment manual, warranty condition or written quotation.

2. Product selection and compatibility

The buyer or operator must confirm the correct product, viscosity or grade, performance specification, compatibility, quantity and changeover procedure for the specific vehicle, machine, component, operating conditions and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) requirements. If uncertain, obtain competent advice before use.

Mixing products, contamination, incorrect storage, use outside specification or failure to follow OEM requirements can cause damage or unsafe operation.

3. Specifications and claims

Any reference to SAE, ISO, API, ACEA, OEM, AUS 32 or another standard must be read with the current documentation for the product actually quoted and supplied. “Meets”, “suitable for”, “recommended for” and formal approval are not interchangeable claims. A specific approval should be relied upon only where confirmed in current authorised documentation.

For SkyBlue 32 and other controlled fluids, request the applicable batch, conformity, SDS or TDS information where required for procurement or use.

4. Safety, storage and environmental handling

Follow the product label and SDS for personal protective equipment, storage, spill response, first aid, transport, disposal and environmental precautions. Keep products in correctly labelled containers and away from children, food, incompatible materials and contamination sources. Report an emergency to the appropriate emergency service and consult the SDS.

5. Images, packaging and availability

Images may be illustrative or digitally produced for brand and range presentation. Actual labels, packaging, colours, closures and pack formats may differ. Product availability, pricing, formulation, documentation and delivery are confirmed at quotation or order stage.

6. No warranty created by website content

No additional warranty or guarantee arises only from this website. Any applicable statutory rights and the express written terms accepted for a supply transaction remain unaffected.
